selection_rule.description: Each open input uses the highest stable release published on or before the cutoff, two weeks before the manifest date. TI inputs use the versions declared by the selected SDK. A newer pin requires a manifest revision.

inputs.name: BeagleBoard distros catalog (os_list.json)
inputs.notes: Publishes the image URL, sizes, and both SHA-256 values recorded in the image entry.

inputs.name: BeagleBone AI-64 Debian 13.7 IoT image, 2026-10-09
inputs.notes: Headless IoT variant selected by the plan. Its derived redistribution remains blocked by LIC-003; using it as an input is allowed.

inputs.name: Block map for the pinned IoT image
inputs.notes: SHA-256 computed on 2026-10-18 from the commit-pinned URL.

inputs.name: Syft inventory for the pinned IoT image
inputs.notes: Syft native JSON despite the .spdx.json suffix. SHA-256 computed on 2026-10-18 from the commit-pinned URL.

inputs.name: Linux kernel package in the pinned image
inputs.notes: Includes the board DTBs under /boot/dtbs/6.18.55-arm64-k3-r59/. Task 009 records the booted kernel, configuration, and DTB hashes before qualification.

inputs.name: Kernel source for the image kernel
inputs.notes: Annotated tag object 5169ebfdd2f3afdb1bda4a0adc6e5a6acfe6977f. Corresponding-source evidence for Gate 6 must also capture the packaging configuration.

inputs.name: BeagleBoard device-tree and overlay sources
inputs.notes: Branch head on the image date; the image carries a checkout under /opt/source. Task 012 audits k3-j721e-ti-ipc-firmware.dtsi and reserved memory against this revision.

inputs.name: U-Boot package in the pinned image
inputs.notes: Students never modify U-Boot. Its source revision is a Gate 6 corresponding-source item under LIC-003.

inputs.name: TI Processor SDK RTOS J721E
inputs.notes: SHA-256 published by TI. Not downloaded: acquisition waits for Task 005 to record the exact no-cost terms and for the maintainer's confirmation.

inputs.name: TI Processor SDK RTOS J721E prebuilt package
inputs.notes: Candidate source of TI's prebuilt remote-core reference firmware for the Task 013 IPC proof. Its exact firmware contents are inventoried at acquisition.

inputs.name: TI Platform Development Kit
inputs.notes: Folder version from the SDK components page link target. Supplies drivers, CSL, IPC, and the bundled FreeRTOS kernel.

inputs.name: TI C7x DSPLIB
inputs.notes: The components page says 11.00.00.01 while the SDK manifest says 11.02.00. Task 019 records the folder actually present in the hashed archive and revises this entry.

inputs.name: TI MMALIB
inputs.notes: The components page says 11.02.00.11 while the SDK manifest says 11.02.01. Task 019 resolves it from the hashed archive.

inputs.name: TI C6000 Code Generation Tools, Linux installer
inputs.notes: The version declared by PSDK RTOS 11.02.01.03. SHA-256 published by TI.

inputs.name: TI C7000 Code Generation Tools, Linux installer
inputs.notes: The version declared by PSDK RTOS 11.02.01.03. SHA-256 published by TI.

inputs.name: FreeRTOS kernel
inputs.notes: The PDK release notes name FreeRTOS kernel tag V10.5.1. Task 019 compares the PDK copy with this upstream commit and classifies TI port files separately.

inputs.name: Ubuntu 22.04 base image
inputs.notes: Dockerfiles reference the image by digest; the tag is informational.

inputs.name: Ubuntu 22.04 package set from the snapshot archive
inputs.notes: Explicitly requested packages only; Task 017 installs from this snapshot and records the full dependency closure. InRelease signatures were verified with the Ubuntu archive keyring on 2026-10-18. Clang 15 and GCC 12 are the newest supported compilers in this archive; the aarch64 cross compilers build host code for the board.

inputs.name: Node.js runtime for markdownlint-cli2
inputs.notes: Jod LTS line. markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3 requires Node.js 22 or newer, which Ubuntu 22.04 does not package.

inputs.name: Trivy
inputs.notes: The vulnerability database is a separate mutable input; Task 024 defines its update and retention policy.

inputs.name: lychee link checker
inputs.notes: Selected by Task 004 as the documentation link checker: one static binary, offline local-link mode, checksummed releases, MIT OR Apache-2.0.

inputs.name: Cppcheck engine and misra.py add-on
inputs.notes: Built from source in Task 017; Ubuntu 22.04 packages only 2.7. Task 024 derives the enforced MISRA-oriented subset from this exact revision.

inputs.name: CMock
inputs.notes: Task 023 pins the vendored submodules and Ruby dependencies when it adopts CMock.

inputs.name: cmakelang (PyPI)
inputs.notes: The latest cmakelang release dates from 2020. Task 017 confirms it runs on Python 3.10 or replaces it through a matrix revision.

inputs.name: reuse (PyPI)
inputs.notes: Source distribution; no wheel targets Python 3.10 with glibc 2.35. Task 017 locks build and runtime dependencies with hashes.

inputs.name: jsonschema (PyPI)
inputs.notes: Required by the repository's manifest validators. Task 017 locks its transitive dependencies with hashes.

inputs.name: markdownlint-cli2 (npm)
inputs.notes: Task 017 commits a package-lock.json with integrity for the transitive closure.

inputs.name: BuildKit builder image
inputs.notes: Used as the Buildx docker-container driver image locally and in CI.

inputs.name: Dockerfile frontend
inputs.notes: Referenced by digest in each Dockerfile syntax directive.

inputs.name: GitHub-hosted runner image

integrity.label: ubuntu-24.04
integrity.image_version_evidence: Every job records the runner image version from the ImageOS and ImageVersion environment variables.

inputs.notes: GitHub updates hosted images weekly. Builds run inside the digest-pinned container, so the runner only supplies Docker and Git.

deferred.name: TI Linux firmware repository revision for J721E remote cores
deferred.reason: git.ti.com timed out or refused connections throughout 2026-10-18, so no commit could be read from the primary source.

deferred.name: ti-rpmsg-char host library full commit
deferred.reason: TI's Linux SDK manifest gives only the abbreviated commit 057b1a2492 for 0.6.10, git.ti.com was unreachable, and Task 027 has not decided whether the library is used.

deferred.name: Minimum Docker Engine, Buildx, and Compose versions for Tier 1 hosts
deferred.reason: Host prerequisites are qualified on a clean machine rather than downloaded by the build.
